units.text: Supporting Information Tuning Thermal Conductivity of Amorphous PAA Polymer via Vapor Phase Infiltration

Schematic diagram of the experimental procedure. The diagram shows the preparation process of the neat PAA, the PAA/Al2O3/#, and the PAA/ZnO/# films. For the characterization of the thermal conductivity of the films, the TDTR measurement was performed. See the main text for details. TDTR measurement. (A) Typical sample configurations of a thin film for TDTR measurement with concentric pump and probe beam. Samples are usually coated with a thin metal transducer layer, like Au. (B) Schematic of a The increase in the through-plane thermal conductivity (k ⊥ ) of the PAA/ZnO films with different ZnO ALD cycles. As compared to the neat PAA film, the thermal conductivity of the PAA/ZnO was measured to be gradually increased with the ALD cycle. The PAA/ZnO/# means PAA with ZnO deposited by # ZnO ALD cycles.
The optimized adsorption state for TMA on the COOH group of PAA.
